descriptionHtml:
TA POS 405-A Heavy Duty Electronic Cash Drawer (6.5KG)

Secure and optimize your retail or hospitality point-of-sale ecosystem with the ultra-robust TA POS 405-A Heavy Duty Electronic Cash Drawer. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium hardware component weighs a massive 6.5KG, signaling its exceptionally thick, reinforced steel outer shell. It stands as the definitive choice for superstores, busy restaurants, and high-volume retail shops across Egypt looking for a secure hardware modification to withstand demanding daily cycles and speed up checkout tracking performance.

The TA POS 405-A features a smooth-glide roller bearing suspension system equipped with a reliable 3-position key lock, allowing for manual open, electronic online control, and secure locking configurations. It houses an adjustable interior layout with 5 spacious bill compartments featuring heavy-duty metal wire grips alongside a removable 5-compartment coin tray. Outfitted with a standard RJ11 printer-driven interface, it ensures seamless integration with standard POS receipt printers to automate your daily desktop checkout ecosystem.
